run_asynchronous_simulation_loop: run the asynchronous engine simulation loop with game masters and entities for a given number of max steps
test_next_acting_entity_selection: test that next_acting returns only the entities passed to it and filters by game master eligibility
test_entity_loop_eligibility: test the entity loop skips actions when an entity is not eligible and acts when it is eligible
test_ban_unban_entities_mid_simulation: test banning an entity from acting and unban it mid simulation to verify dynamic eligibility changes
test_thread_safe_logging: test that the asynchronous engine log lock prevents race conditions by verifying each thread logs its own entity entry
